sloka: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः ।क्षिप्रं सुनिशितैर्बाणैर्हन्यतां युधि रावणः ।। ५.६७.२१ ।।।।
transliteration: tasya vīryavataḥ kaścidyadyasti mayi sambhramaḥ ।kṣipraṁ suniśitairbāṇairhanyatāṁ yudhi rāvaṇaḥ ।। 5.67.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "For what reason does that best of men, Raghava, not protect me? Those two tigers among men, of splendour equal to wind and fire, are able —
